summary: SoftBank transferred its 89,106,748 shares of Class A Common Stock to Tether International, and SoftBank's 89,106,748 shares of Class B Common Stock were cancelled in connection with the transaction. This changes the composition of outstanding shares (Class B shares reduced by 89,106,748) but the document does not state new total share counts outstanding.

10-Q for Q1 2026 (period ended March 31, 2026) shows 346,548,153 Class A shares and 304,842,759 Class B shares outstanding (total ~651.4M shares basic), convertible notes payable of ~$484.4M carrying value ($486.5M face at closing per Note 4), and no preferred stock outstanding; BTC holdings not explicitly stated in coins in the excerpts provided.

The 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 discloses the completed Business Combination: Twenty One Capital holds Bitcoin contributed/purchased through multiple PIPE tranches (31,500 BTC contribution + ~5,004 initial PIPE BTC + ~917 option PIPE BTC + ~1,381 June PIPE BTC + ~392 in-kind PIPE BTC ≈ ~36,504 BTC net at closing, as of 2025-12-31 per balance sheet date), and issued $486.5M face value of 1.00% convertible senior secured notes due 2030 (including $340.2M subscription notes, $100M option notes, and $46.3M exchange notes); exact shares outstanding as of filing date were not extractable from the provided excerpts.

Business Combination closed December 8, 2025: Pubco (XXI) issued $486.5M of 1.00% convertible senior notes due 2030 (conversion rate 72.0841 shares per $1,000, implying ~$13.87/share conversion price); shares outstanding as of closing are 346,548,153 Class A and 304,842,759 Class B. BTC holdings at closing are not explicitly restated as a single total figure in the document.

The 10-Q (covering period through September 30, 2025, filed after the December 8, 2025 closing) discloses that at closing Pubco issued $486.5 million of 1.0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 (up from the previously modeled $485M face value); BTC holdings and share counts as of the September 30, 2025 balance sheet date reflect only the predecessor/shell entities with no Bitcoin on balance sheet yet, as the business combination closed after the reporting period.

Three material corrections vs. the current model: (1) BTC rises from 36,504 to 43,514 — the model held the December 8, 2025 closing figure; the Q1 2026 10-Q (primary SEC source, period ended 2026-03-31) confirms 43,514 BTC, matching all treasury trackers, and no further purchases have been disclosed since; (2) shares_basic rises from 346,548,153 to 562,284,164 — the model counted only Class A shares; the dual-class structure also includes Class B, which stood at 304,842,759 at Q1 end but was reduced to 215,736,011 after SoftBank's 89,106,748 Class B shares were cancelled on 2026-05-19 per the May 2026 8-K filings (primary source wins over tracker data); (3) the converts list is collapsed to a single tranche ($486.5M face, 1.00%, due 2030-12-01, conversion price $13.873) — all four duplicate/overlapping entries in the prior model refer to the same instrument, confirmed by the indenture terms disclosed in the POS AM and 424B3 filings; debt_face and cash are unchanged at $486.5M and $114.1M respectively as of the Q1 2026 balance sheet.

Owner-approved: debt_face 486,500,000 -> 0. The baseline research read debt_face as total debt, but the only debt IS the $486.5M 1% convert already listed as a tranche (model convention: straight debt excluding converts; prompt fixed in 77ed3c8 after this pilot).
